knownLimits: The decision-event seam is READY BUT NOT ACTIVATED: tui.dsh/v1alpha1#DecisionEvents cannot be registered by a profile-installed plugin (admission is token-gated and unreachable at host revision b246411). The attempt is wrapped, the refusal is logged once, and no input/rewind/session-switch/compact interception is claimed. admit()/admitInternal/the test-only token are never used, and no identity is faked.

The /settings section declares the real .mpd/mpd.jsonc knobs but edits them under the harness settings namespace mpd (registered so the screen does not render the section as unavailable). No bridge to .mpd/mpd.jsonc ships in this wave — disclosed in src/settings.ts, both READMEs and the packaged skill.
The packaged skill packages/mpd-tui-plugin/skills/mpd-tui/SKILL.md is an asset only: the bundle corpus is served from <bundle>/skills by mpd-bootstrap, so this row does not register it.

Web-only surfaces (agent-teams sidebar, workmate tab, bundle floater) have no TUI rendering face; the board/status/dialogs are equivalents, not parity. The web profile is untouched (this row is inert without TUI services).

Live TUI rendering (panels lane), the manifest/admission lanes, the seam-API audit against host source and the repo regression sweep are other tasks lanes (t7/t8/t9/t10) — this task proves the artifact, the plugin contract, the degraded composition and the refusal containment only.

The Config schema and the settings namespace schema come from the schemastery copy the bundle already vendors at packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin/_deps/schemastery (the one relative specifier that names a package directory, resolved through its package.json). The built bundle inlines it, so the shipped artifact performs no runtime module resolution beyond Node builtins.

The log-only session record (mpd-tui/board-opened) is appended only after registration.ts VERIFIED that a reachable dsh-session copy knows the type; in a layout where no anchor resolves the live copy the record is skipped by design (iron rule 2) rather than risking an unresumable session.

correction.status: THE RECORD BELOW IS NOT VALID AS A VERIFICATION OF THE PACKAGE IN A REAL BOOT
whatIsWrong: criterion 3 ("seven seams register when present, refusal logged once") is recorded as passed on the strength of unit tests whose fake context returned services from ctx.get() unconditionally. In a real dsh-tui boot the artifact registered NOTHING: a service is only reachable from a context that INJECTED it, so an inject-free row gets undefined for commands, settings and every tui* service (measured with instrumented rows: mount-instrumentation/FINDING.md, report-no-inject.json vs report-with-inject.json).
criterion 2's "no thrown error when every TUI service is absent" was true but empty: the package was equally inert WITH the services present.
